An APSIM result as a contract-emitting manifest

Source: R/manifest.R
apsim_manifest.Rd

The typed result every verb returns. inferential_target follows the orchestra contract enum ("predictions", "parameters"); params carries a fitted-parameter table (empty for a pure prediction); outputs carries the simulated report; provenance pins the APSIM version, an integrity hash, and the seed.

Usage

apsim_manifest(
  inferential_target,
  method,
  params = data.frame(),
  outputs = NULL,
  metadata = list(),
  seed = NA_integer_
)

Arguments

inferential_target

Character: "predictions", "parameters", "sensitivity", "emulator" or "validation".

method

Character method tag, for example "apsim:predict".

params

A data.frame of fitted parameters (default empty).

outputs

The simulated report (data.frame) or NULL.

metadata

A named list of auxiliary provenance.

seed

Integer RNG seed (NA when none).

Value

An apsim_manifest S7 object.

Examples

m <- apsim_manifest("parameters", "apsim:estimate:mitscherlich",
                    params = data.frame(ymax = 4.2, rate = 0.018, y0 = 1.1))
m@inferential_target
#> [1] "parameters"
